groups.title: WhatsApp Groups
groups.subtitle: Groups your connected number belongs to. When an order is confirmed, it is posted into the customer's group and the customer is @mentioned. Give a group an ordering code so customers can order from it.

row.label: Ordering code for {name}
row.badChars: Use letters, numbers, dots, dashes and underscores only.
row.taken: Another group already uses this code.

empty.title: No groups yet
empty.message: The group list is copied from your connected WhatsApp session. Groups appear here once that session has synced them; no time is promised for it yet.

noMatch.title: No groups match your search
noMatch.message: Try another part of the group name, or clear the search.

how.title: How ordering codes work
how.body: Give a group a short code (for example ACME), then share its ordering link. When a customer taps it and confirms an order, the order is posted straight into that exact group and the customer is @mentioned, even if they belong to several groups.
